<p>现在是时候升级一下了，总结了一下常用的一些地图底图下载。</p>
<h2 data-id="heading-0">1.坐标系</h2>
<p>目前国内常用坐标系有</p>
<ul>
<li>国家大地坐标系CGCS2000(EPSG:4547)</li>
<li>百度坐标系BD09</li>
<li>火星坐标系GCJ02</li>
<li>国际通用坐标系WGS84（EPSG:4326）</li>
</ul>
<p>更多的地理坐标系可以到<code>https://epsg.io/</code>搜索，获取相关配置</p>
<p>EPSG地理坐标系一般可以使用<code>proj4</code>对坐标系进行转换，比如</p>
<p>国家大地坐标系CGCS2000与国际通用坐标系WGS84的相互转换</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-ts" lang="ts"><span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> proj4 <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">"proj4"</span>;
<span class="hljs-comment">// CGCS2000地理坐标系</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> cgcs2000 = <span class="hljs-string">"+proj=tmerc +lat_0=0 +lon_0=114 +k=1 +x_0=500000 +y_0=0 +ellps=GRS80 +units=m +no_defs"</span>;
<span class="hljs-comment">// WGS84地理坐标系</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> wgs84 = <span class="hljs-string">"+proj=longlat +datum=WGS84 +no_defs"</span>;
{
  <span class="hljs-comment">//将CGCS2000坐标转换为WGS84坐标</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> [lng, lat] = <span class="hljs-title function_">proj4</span>(cgcs2000, wgs84, [<span class="hljs-number">495741.2653999999</span>, <span class="hljs-number">2499953.2905</span>]);
  <span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(lng, lat); <span class="hljs-comment">//113.95858231900118 22.597395765246997</span>
}
{
  <span class="hljs-comment">// 将WGS84坐标转换为CGCS2000坐标</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> [lng, lat] = <span class="hljs-title function_">proj4</span>(wgs84, cgcs2000, [<span class="hljs-number">113</span>, <span class="hljs-number">22</span>]);
  <span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(lng, lat); <span class="hljs-comment">//396734.05319196207 2434138.0838125898</span>
}
</code></pre>
<p>百度坐标系BD09和火星坐标系GCJ02可以使用<code>gcoord</code>进行转换</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-ts" lang="ts"><span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> gcoord <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">"gcoord"</span>;
{
  <span class="hljs-comment">//将WGS84坐标转换成BD09</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> [lng, lat] = gcoord.<span class="hljs-title function_">transform</span>([<span class="hljs-number">113</span>, <span class="hljs-number">22</span>], gcoord.<span class="hljs-property">WGS84</span>, gcoord.<span class="hljs-property">BD09</span>);
  <span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(lng, lat); <span class="hljs-comment">//113.01173112892457 22.00318110953146</span>
}
{
  <span class="hljs-comment">//将WGS84坐标转换成GCJ02</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> [lng, lat] = gcoord.<span class="hljs-title function_">transform</span>([<span class="hljs-number">113</span>, <span class="hljs-number">22</span>], gcoord.<span class="hljs-property">WGS84</span>, gcoord.<span class="hljs-property">GCJ02</span>);
  <span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(lng, lat); <span class="hljs-comment">//113.00519647627083 21.997261931400583</span>
}
</code></pre>
<p><strong>工具类</strong>
创建地图投影</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-ts" lang="ts"> <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> {name, config, origin, resolutions} = projConfig;
  <span class="hljs-comment">//定义投影</span>
  proj4.<span class="hljs-title function_">defs</span>(name, config);

  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-attr">scales</span>: <span class="hljs-built_in">number</span>[] = [];
  <span class="hljs-comment">//lods配置</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (resolutions?.<span class="hljs-property">length</span>) {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> (<span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> i = resolutions.<span class="hljs-property">length</span> - <span class="hljs-number">1</span>; i &gt;= <span class="hljs-number">0</span>; i--) {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (resolutions[i]) {
        scales[i] = <span class="hljs-number">1</span> / resolutions[i];
      }
    }
  }
</code></pre>
<p>坐标转换</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-ts" lang="ts"><span class="hljs-comment">//坐标偏移</span>
    <span class="hljs-attr">transformation</span>: (<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> (<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
      <span class="hljs-comment">//原点位置偏移</span>
      <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (origin?.<span class="hljs-property">length</span>) {
        <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Transformation</span>(<span class="hljs-number">1</span>, -origin[<span class="hljs-number">0</span>], -<span class="hljs-number">1</span>, origin[<span class="hljs-number">1</span>]);
      }
      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> scale = <span class="hljs-number">0.5</span> / (<span class="hljs-title class_">Math</span>.<span class="hljs-property">PI</span> * <span class="hljs-variable constant_">EARTH_R</span>);
      <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Transformation</span>(scale, <span class="hljs-number">0.5</span>, -scale, <span class="hljs-number">0.5</span>);
    })(),
    <span class="hljs-comment">//投影坐标</span>
    <span class="hljs-title function_">project</span>(<span class="hljs-attr">lnglat</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">LngLatXY</span>): <span class="hljs-title class_">LngLatXY</span> {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">proj4</span>(name).<span class="hljs-title function_">forward</span>(lnglat);
    },
    <span class="hljs-comment">//逆投影坐标</span>
    <span class="hljs-title function_">unproject</span>(<span class="hljs-attr">xy</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">LngLatXY</span>): <span class="hljs-title class_">LngLatXY</span> {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">proj4</span>(name).<span class="hljs-title function_">inverse</span>(xy);
    },
    <span class="hljs-comment">//经纬度转像素坐标</span>
    <span class="hljs-title function_">lnglat2px</span>(<span class="hljs-attr">lnglat</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">LngLatXY</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">zoom</span>: <span class="hljs-built_in">number</span>): <span class="hljs-title class_">LngLatXY</span> {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> p = <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">project</span>(lnglat);
      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> scale = <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">scale</span>(zoom);
      <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">transformation</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">transform</span>(p, scale);
    },
    <span class="hljs-comment">//像素坐标转经纬度</span>
    <span class="hljs-title function_">px2lnglat</span>(<span class="hljs-attr">xy</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">LngLatXY</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">zoom</span>: <span class="hljs-built_in">number</span>): <span class="hljs-title class_">LngLatXY</span> {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> scale = <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">scale</span>(zoom);
      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> p = <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">transformation</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">untransform</span>(xy, scale);
      <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">unproject</span>(p);
    },
</code></pre>
<p>缩放等级和像素大小可以参考leaflet和proj4leaflet的代码,默认球面墨卡托投影。</p>
<p>计算该缩放等级的像素大小</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-ts" lang="ts"><span class="hljs-title function_">scale</span>(<span class="hljs-params">zoom: <span class="hljs-built_in">number</span></span>) {
      <span class="hljs-comment">//lods等级的像素大小</span>
      <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (resolutions?.<span class="hljs-property">length</span>) {
        <span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> iZoom = <span class="hljs-title class_">Math</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">floor</span>(zoom),
          baseScale,
          nextScale,
          scaleDiff,
          zDiff;
        <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (zoom === iZoom) {
          <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> scales[zoom];
        } <span class="hljs-keyword">else</span> {
          <span class="hljs-comment">// Non-integer zoom, interpolate</span>
          baseScale = scales[iZoom];
          nextScale = scales[iZoom + <span class="hljs-number">1</span>];
          scaleDiff = nextScale - baseScale;
          zDiff = zoom - iZoom;
          <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> baseScale + scaleDiff * zDiff;
        }
      }
      <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="hljs-number">256</span> * <span class="hljs-title class_">Math</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">pow</span>(<span class="hljs-number">2</span>, zoom);
    }
</code></pre>
<p>计算该像素大小对应的缩放等级</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-ts" lang="ts">    <span class="hljs-title function_">zoom</span>(<span class="hljs-params">scale: <span class="hljs-built_in">number</span></span>) {
      <span class="hljs-comment">//lods缩放等级</span>
      <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (resolutions?.<span class="hljs-property">length</span>) {
        <span class="hljs-comment">// Find closest number in this._scales, down</span>
        <span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> downScale = <span class="hljs-title function_">closestElement</span>(scales, scale);
        <span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> downZoom = scales.<span class="hljs-title function_">indexOf</span>(downScale!),
          nextScale,
          nextZoom,
          scaleDiff;
        <span class="hljs-comment">// Check if scale is downScale =&gt; return array index</span>
        <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (scale === downScale) {
          <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> downZoom;
        }
        <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (downScale === <span class="hljs-literal">undefined</span>) {
          <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> -<span class="hljs-title class_">Infinity</span>;
        }
        <span class="hljs-comment">// Interpolate</span>
        nextZoom = downZoom + <span class="hljs-number">1</span>;
        nextScale = scales[nextZoom];
        <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (nextScale === <span class="hljs-literal">undefined</span>) {
          <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Infinity</span>;
        }
        scaleDiff = nextScale - downScale;
        <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> (scale - downScale) / scaleDiff + downZoom;
      }
      <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Math</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(scale / <span class="hljs-number">256</span>) / <span class="hljs-title class_">Math</span>.<span class="hljs-property">LN2</span>;
    },
</code></pre>
<h2 data-id="heading-1">2. 瓦片底图下载</h2>
<h3 data-id="heading-2">2.1 手写canvas地图</h3>
<p>获取瓦片的Image对象</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-ts" lang="ts"> <span class="hljs-title function_">getTileImage</span>(<span class="hljs-params">x: <span class="hljs-built_in">number</span>, y: <span class="hljs-built_in">number</span>, z: <span class="hljs-built_in">number</span></span>) {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Promise</span>&lt;<span class="hljs-title class_">HTMLImageElement</span> | <span class="hljs-literal">null</span>&gt;(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">resolve, reject</span>) =&gt;</span> {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> id = <span class="hljs-string">`<span class="hljs-subst">${x}</span>-<span class="hljs-subst">${y}</span>-<span class="hljs-subst">${z}</span>`</span>;
      <span class="hljs-comment">//缓存瓦片底图</span>
      <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">cacheTiles</span>[id] !== <span class="hljs-literal">undefined</span>) {
        <span class="hljs-title function_">resolve</span>(<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">cacheTiles</span>[id]);
      } <span class="hljs-keyword">else</span> {
        <span class="hljs-comment">//加载瓦片底图</span>
        <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> url = <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">tileUrl</span>
          .<span class="hljs-title function_">replace</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'{x}'</span>, <span class="hljs-title class_">String</span>(x))
          .<span class="hljs-title function_">replace</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'{y}'</span>, <span class="hljs-title class_">String</span>(y))
          .<span class="hljs-title function_">replace</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'{z}'</span>, <span class="hljs-title class_">String</span>(z));
        <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> image = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Image</span>();
        image.<span class="hljs-property">src</span> = url;
        image.<span class="hljs-property">crossOrigin</span> = <span class="hljs-string">'anonymous'</span>;
        image.<span class="hljs-property">onload</span> = <span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> {
          <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">cacheTiles</span>[id] = image;
          <span class="hljs-title function_">resolve</span>(image);
        };
        image.<span class="hljs-property">onerror</span> = <span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> {
          <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">cacheTiles</span>[id] = <span class="hljs-literal">null</span>;
          <span class="hljs-title function_">reject</span>(image);
        };
      }
    });
  }
</code></pre>
<p>canvas绘制瓦片Image</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-ts" lang="ts"><span class="hljs-keyword">async</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">drawTileImage</span>(<span class="hljs-params">
  ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D,
  x: <span class="hljs-built_in">number</span>,
  y: <span class="hljs-built_in">number</span>,
  z: <span class="hljs-built_in">number</span>,
  imageX: <span class="hljs-built_in">number</span>,
  imageY: <span class="hljs-built_in">number</span>
</span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">try</span> {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> image = <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">getTileImage</span>(x, y, z);
    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (image) {
      ctx.<span class="hljs-title function_">drawImage</span>(image, imageX, imageY);
    }
  } <span class="hljs-keyword">catch</span> (error) {}
}
</code></pre>
<p>计算瓦片范围与相关参数</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-ts" lang="ts"><span class="hljs-title function_">getTileBounds</span>(<span class="hljs-params">center?: LngLatXY, zoom?: <span class="hljs-built_in">number</span></span>) {
    <span class="hljs-comment">//中心经纬度转像素坐标</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> tileCenter = <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">lnglat2xy</span>(center ?? <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">center</span>, zoom ?? <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">zoom</span>);
    <span class="hljs-comment">//canvas大小</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> mapSize = <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">getMapSize</span>();
    <span class="hljs-comment">//取一半，获取左上点和右下点相对于中心点的像素坐标</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> halfWidth = mapSize[<span class="hljs-number">0</span>] * <span class="hljs-number">0.5</span>;
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> halfHeight = mapSize[<span class="hljs-number">1</span>] * <span class="hljs-number">0.5</span>;
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-attr">start</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">LngLatXY</span> = [tileCenter[<span class="hljs-number">0</span>] - halfWidth, tileCenter[<span class="hljs-number">1</span>] - halfHeight];
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-attr">end</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">LngLatXY</span> = [tileCenter[<span class="hljs-number">0</span>] + halfWidth, tileCenter[<span class="hljs-number">1</span>] + halfHeight];
    <span class="hljs-comment">//瓦片底图是tileSize x tileSize大小的图片，计算瓦片范围</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> bounds = [
      [<span class="hljs-title class_">Math</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">floor</span>(start[<span class="hljs-number">0</span>] / <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">tileSize</span>), <span class="hljs-title class_">Math</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">floor</span>(start[<span class="hljs-number">1</span>] / <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">tileSize</span>)],
      [<span class="hljs-title class_">Math</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">ceil</span>(end[<span class="hljs-number">0</span>] / <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">tileSize</span>), <span class="hljs-title class_">Math</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">ceil</span>(end[<span class="hljs-number">1</span>] / <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">tileSize</span>)]
    ];
    <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> {
      tileCenter,
      bounds,
      start,
      end,
      <span class="hljs-comment">//瓦片开始像素坐标相对canvas可视范围的左上点像素坐标偏移</span>
      <span class="hljs-attr">offset</span>: [bounds[<span class="hljs-number">0</span>][<span class="hljs-number">0</span>] * <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">tileSize</span> - start[<span class="hljs-number">0</span>], bounds[<span class="hljs-number">0</span>][<span class="hljs-number">1</span>] * <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">tileSize</span> - start[<span class="hljs-number">1</span>]]
    };
  }
</code></pre>
<p>绘制瓦片底图</p>
<ul>
<li>计算地图可视范围，收集瓦片索引与位置</li>
<li>排序绘制瓦片的顺序，优先绘制有缓存的瓦片</li>
<li>触发6个并发请求加载图片并绘制到canvas上</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="hljs language-ts" lang="ts"><span class="hljs-keyword">async</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">drawLayer</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> ctx = <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">ctx</span>;
    ctx.<span class="hljs-title function_">clearRect</span>(<span class="hljs-number">0</span>, <span class="hljs-number">0</span>, <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">canvas</span>.<span class="hljs-property">width</span>, <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">canvas</span>.<span class="hljs-property">height</span>);
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> {offset, bounds, start, end, tileCenter} = <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">getTileBounds</span>();
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">tileCenter</span> = tileCenter;
    <span class="hljs-comment">//开始像素坐标</span>
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">tileStart</span> = start;
    <span class="hljs-comment">//结束像素坐标</span>
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">tileEnd</span> = end;
    <span class="hljs-comment">//收集需要绘制的瓦片索引和瓦片在canvas上的位置</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> queue = [];
    <span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> (<span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> x = bounds[<span class="hljs-number">0</span>][<span class="hljs-number">0</span>], i = <span class="hljs-number">0</span>; x &lt; bounds[<span class="hljs-number">1</span>][<span class="hljs-number">0</span>]; x++, i++) {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> (<span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> y = bounds[<span class="hljs-number">0</span>][<span class="hljs-number">1</span>], j = <span class="hljs-number">0</span>; y &lt; bounds[<span class="hljs-number">1</span>][<span class="hljs-number">1</span>]; y++, j++) {
        queue.<span class="hljs-title function_">push</span>({
          x,
          y,
          <span class="hljs-attr">imageX</span>: i * <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">tileSize</span> + offset[<span class="hljs-number">0</span>],
          <span class="hljs-attr">imageY</span>: j * <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">tileSize</span> + offset[<span class="hljs-number">1</span>]
        });
      }
    }
    <span class="hljs-comment">//排序优先绘制有缓存的瓦片</span>
    queue.<span class="hljs-title function_">sort</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">a: <span class="hljs-built_in">any</span>, b: <span class="hljs-built_in">any</span></span>) =&gt;</span> {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> id1 = <span class="hljs-string">`<span class="hljs-subst">${a.x}</span>-<span class="hljs-subst">${a.y}</span>-<span class="hljs-subst">${<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.zoom}</span>`</span>;
      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> id2 = <span class="hljs-string">`<span class="hljs-subst">${b.x}</span>-<span class="hljs-subst">${b.y}</span>-<span class="hljs-subst">${<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.zoom}</span>`</span>;
      <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">cacheTiles</span>[id1]) <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> -<span class="hljs-number">1</span>;
      <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">cacheTiles</span>[id2]) <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="hljs-number">1</span>;
      <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="hljs-number">0</span>;
    });
    <span class="hljs-comment">//异步加载图片绘制到canvas上，http1.1的同一个域名下TCP并发连接数4-8个，通常6个。</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> (<span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> i = <span class="hljs-number">0</span>; i &lt; queue.<span class="hljs-property">length</span>; i = i + <span class="hljs-number">6</span>) {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> list = queue.<span class="hljs-title function_">slice</span>(i, i + <span class="hljs-number">6</span>);
      <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Promise</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">all</span>(
        list.<span class="hljs-title function_">map</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">a</span>) =&gt;</span> <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">drawTileImage</span>(ctx, a.<span class="hljs-property">x</span>, a.<span class="hljs-property">y</span>, <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">zoom</span>, a.<span class="hljs-property">imageX</span>, a.<span class="hljs-property">imageY</span>))
      );
    }
    <span class="hljs-comment">//绘制形状</span>
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">drawShape</span>();
  }
</code></pre>
<p>以下地图瓦片采用的是天地图</p>
<p><img src="https://p6-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/ac2921dc6249441d831bab93c0e0ce2b~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5pWy5pWy5pWy5pWy5pq05L2g6ISR6KKL:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1788767980&amp;x-signature=4ThXPhBPQyJnrWXdFZSPFbYlo0w%3D" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>另外可以根据需要设置自己需要的地图投影，如果使用了arcgis地图服务可以根据<code>/MapServer?f=json</code>获取<code>tileInfo</code>并配置原点origin、缩放层级lods、瓦片大小、最大最小缩放层级、投影坐标系等。投影坐标系配置可以到<code>https://epsg.io/</code>搜索。</p>

<h3 data-id="heading-3">2.2 下载瓦片</h3>
<p>框选范围后，获取某范围内要下载层级的瓦片地址与xyz</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-ts" lang="ts"> <span class="hljs-title function_">getTileList</span>(<span class="hljs-params">rect: [LngLatXY, LngLatXY], zoom: <span class="hljs-built_in">number</span></span>) {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-attr">p1</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">LngLatXY</span> = <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">lnglat2xy</span>(rect[<span class="hljs-number">0</span>], zoom);
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-attr">p2</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">LngLatXY</span> = <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">lnglat2xy</span>(rect[<span class="hljs-number">1</span>], zoom);
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> start = [<span class="hljs-title class_">Math</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">min</span>(p1[<span class="hljs-number">0</span>], p2[<span class="hljs-number">0</span>]), <span class="hljs-title class_">Math</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">min</span>(p1[<span class="hljs-number">1</span>], p2[<span class="hljs-number">1</span>])];
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> end = [<span class="hljs-title class_">Math</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">max</span>(p1[<span class="hljs-number">0</span>], p2[<span class="hljs-number">0</span>]), <span class="hljs-title class_">Math</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">max</span>(p1[<span class="hljs-number">1</span>], p2[<span class="hljs-number">1</span>])];
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 计算瓦片范围</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> bounds = [
      [<span class="hljs-title class_">Math</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">floor</span>(start[<span class="hljs-number">0</span>] / <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">tileSize</span>), <span class="hljs-title class_">Math</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">floor</span>(start[<span class="hljs-number">1</span>] / <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">tileSize</span>)],
      [<span class="hljs-title class_">Math</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">ceil</span>(end[<span class="hljs-number">0</span>] / <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">tileSize</span>), <span class="hljs-title class_">Math</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">ceil</span>(end[<span class="hljs-number">1</span>] / <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">tileSize</span>)]
    ];

    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-attr">queue</span>: <span class="hljs-built_in">any</span>[] = [];
    <span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> (<span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> x = bounds[<span class="hljs-number">0</span>][<span class="hljs-number">0</span>], i = <span class="hljs-number">0</span>; x &lt; bounds[<span class="hljs-number">1</span>][<span class="hljs-number">0</span>]; x++, i++) {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> (<span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> y = bounds[<span class="hljs-number">0</span>][<span class="hljs-number">1</span>], j = <span class="hljs-number">0</span>; y &lt; bounds[<span class="hljs-number">1</span>][<span class="hljs-number">1</span>]; y++, j++) {
        <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> url = <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">tileUrl</span>
          .<span class="hljs-title function_">replace</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'{x}'</span>, <span class="hljs-title class_">String</span>(x))
          .<span class="hljs-title function_">replace</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'{y}'</span>, <span class="hljs-title class_">String</span>(y))
          .<span class="hljs-title function_">replace</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'{z}'</span>, <span class="hljs-title class_">String</span>(zoom));
        queue.<span class="hljs-title function_">push</span>({
          x,
          y,
          <span class="hljs-attr">z</span>: zoom,
          url
        });
      }
    }
    <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> queue;
  }
</code></pre>
<p>如果有需要下载大缩放层级的时候，瓦片数量过多，会出现溢出的情况，这时候则需要进行分包下载。</p>
<p>采用分包下载，需要关闭浏览器【下载前询问每个文件的保存位置】并许网页权限【自动下载项】</p>
<p><img src="https://p6-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/a95679a9c94542919145795bd479cc57~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5pWy5pWy5pWy5pWy5pq05L2g6ISR6KKL:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1788767980&amp;x-signature=Qu6g7GGaRQx5ZT6Sjej%2FR2MDSMA%3D" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://p6-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/c323146efb34422dad4779ecd71872f2~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5pWy5pWy5pWy5pWy5pq05L2g6ISR6KKL:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1788767980&amp;x-signature=5YHkqW3qZgzL7xO8ZRzo2abUg6o%3D" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-ts" lang="ts"><span class="hljs-attr">download</span>: <span class="hljs-keyword">async</span> () =&gt; {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> {minLevel, maxLevel} = state.<span class="hljs-property">value</span>;

        <span class="hljs-comment">//分包下载</span>

            <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> list = queue.<span class="hljs-title function_">slice</span>(i, i + n);
            <span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(i, i + n, list.<span class="hljs-property">length</span>);
            <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">downloadZip</span>(list, i);

<p>获取图片数据，并写入到zip包中。</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-ts" lang="ts"><span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">downloadZip</span> = (<span class="hljs-params">queue: <span class="hljs-built_in">any</span>[], start: <span class="hljs-built_in">number</span></span>) =&gt; {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Promise</span>(<span class="hljs-keyword">async</span> (resolve) =&gt; {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> {minLevel, maxLevel} = state.<span class="hljs-property">value</span>;
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> zip = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">JSZip</span>();
    <span class="hljs-comment">//异步加载图片绘制到canvas上，http1.1的同一个域名下TCP并发连接数4-8个，通常6个。</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> (<span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> i = <span class="hljs-number">0</span>; i &lt; queue.<span class="hljs-property">length</span>; i += <span class="hljs-number">6</span>) {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> list = queue.<span class="hljs-title function_">slice</span>(i, i + <span class="hljs-number">6</span>);
      store.<span class="hljs-property">value</span>.<span class="hljs-property">current</span> = start + i;
      <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Promise</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">all</span>(list.<span class="hljs-title function_">map</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">a</span>) =&gt;</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">writeZip</span>(zip, a.<span class="hljs-property">url</span>, a.<span class="hljs-property">x</span>, a.<span class="hljs-property">y</span>, a.<span class="hljs-property">z</span>)));
      <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">sleep</span>();
    }

    zip
      .<span class="hljs-title function_">generateAsync</span>({<span class="hljs-attr">type</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'blob'</span>})
      .<span class="hljs-title function_">then</span>(<span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> (<span class="hljs-params">content</span>) {
        <span class="hljs-title function_">downloadFile</span>(
          content,
          <span class="hljs-string">`瓦片层级[<span class="hljs-subst">${minLevel}</span>-<span class="hljs-subst">${maxLevel}</span>][<span class="hljs-subst">${start}</span>]<span class="hljs-subst">${<span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-built_in">Date</span>().getTime()}</span>.zip`</span>
        );
      })
      .<span class="hljs-title function_">finally</span>(<span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> {
        <span class="hljs-title function_">resolve</span>(start);
      });
  });
};
</code></pre>
<p><img src="https://p6-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/e72814b128784db8ba4b2e7b8fb973d5~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5pWy5pWy5pWy5pWy5pq05L2g6ISR6KKL:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1788767980&amp;x-signature=i0nl9jBT8jkqwhukMFslsp6%2BCro%3D" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>下载的分包瓦片直接【解压到当前位置】即可，tiles文件夹下即为所有瓦片分包下载图片的总集</p>
<p><img src="https://p6-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/cf102f9d57854c6682a259c114ee425d~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5pWy5pWy5pWy5pWy5pq05L2g6ISR6KKL:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1788767980&amp;x-signature=gq04xKO%2FsvqRBi52WXDsyyL73F0%3D" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 data-id="heading-4">3. 区域边界图下载</h2>
<p>获取行政区域边界，并绘制，获取行政区域范围</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-ts" lang="ts"><span class="hljs-attr">drawarea</span>: <span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">noFit: <span class="hljs-built_in">boolean</span></span>) =&gt;</span> {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> code = state.<span class="hljs-property">value</span>.<span class="hljs-property">currentArea</span>;
      <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (!code) {
        <span class="hljs-title class_">ElMessage</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">error</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'请选择区域'</span>);
        <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span>;
      }
      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">drawArea</span> = (<span class="hljs-params">res: <span class="hljs-built_in">any</span></span>) =&gt; {
        <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (areaIds.<span class="hljs-property">length</span>) {
          areaIds.<span class="hljs-title function_">forEach</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">id</span>) =&gt;</span> {
            map.<span class="hljs-title function_">removeShape</span>(id);
          });
          areaIds = [];
        }
        <span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> count = <span class="hljs-number">0</span>,id = <span class="hljs-number">0</span>;
        <span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> lng = <span class="hljs-number">0</span>,lat = <span class="hljs-number">0</span>;
        <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> bounds = [[<span class="hljs-title class_">Number</span>.<span class="hljs-property">MAX_SAFE_INTEGER</span>, <span class="hljs-title class_">Number</span>.<span class="hljs-property">MAX_SAFE_INTEGER</span>], [<span class="hljs-number">0</span>, <span class="hljs-number">0</span>]] <span class="hljs-keyword">as</span> [<span class="hljs-title class_">LngLatXY</span>, <span class="hljs-title class_">LngLatXY</span>];
        theGeojson = res;
        map.<span class="hljs-property">isGc</span> = state.<span class="hljs-property">value</span>.<span class="hljs-property">isGc</span>;        
        <span class="hljs-title function_">travelGeo</span>(res, <span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">path: <span class="hljs-built_in">any</span></span>) =&gt;</span> {
          id++;
          <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-attr">ps</span>: <span class="hljs-built_in">any</span>[] = [];
          path.<span class="hljs-title function_">forEach</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">a: <span class="hljs-built_in">any</span></span>) =&gt;</span> {
            <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> b = state.<span class="hljs-property">value</span>.<span class="hljs-property">isGc</span> ? a : <span class="hljs-title function_">gcTowgs84</span>(a[<span class="hljs-number">0</span>], a[<span class="hljs-number">1</span>]);
            ps.<span class="hljs-title function_">push</span>(b);
            count++;
            lng += b[<span class="hljs-number">0</span>];
            lat += b[<span class="hljs-number">1</span>];
            bounds[<span class="hljs-number">0</span>][<span class="hljs-number">0</span>] = <span class="hljs-title class_">Math</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">min</span>(bounds[<span class="hljs-number">0</span>][<span class="hljs-number">0</span>], b[<span class="hljs-number">0</span>]);
            bounds[<span class="hljs-number">0</span>][<span class="hljs-number">1</span>] = <span class="hljs-title class_">Math</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">min</span>(bounds[<span class="hljs-number">0</span>][<span class="hljs-number">1</span>], b[<span class="hljs-number">1</span>]);
            bounds[<span class="hljs-number">1</span>][<span class="hljs-number">0</span>] = <span class="hljs-title class_">Math</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">max</span>(bounds[<span class="hljs-number">1</span>][<span class="hljs-number">0</span>], b[<span class="hljs-number">0</span>]);
            bounds[<span class="hljs-number">1</span>][<span class="hljs-number">1</span>] = <span class="hljs-title class_">Math</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">max</span>(bounds[<span class="hljs-number">1</span>][<span class="hljs-number">1</span>], b[<span class="hljs-number">1</span>]);
          });
          <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> s = code + <span class="hljs-string">'_'</span> + id;
          areaIds.<span class="hljs-title function_">push</span>(s);
          map.<span class="hljs-title function_">addShape</span>({
            <span class="hljs-attr">id</span>: s,
            <span class="hljs-attr">type</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'polygon'</span>,
            <span class="hljs-attr">path</span>: ps,
            <span class="hljs-attr">style</span>: {
              <span class="hljs-attr">stroke</span>: <span class="hljs-literal">true</span>,
              <span class="hljs-attr">color</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'blue'</span>,
              <span class="hljs-attr">opacity</span>: <span class="hljs-number">1</span>,
              <span class="hljs-attr">weight</span>: <span class="hljs-number">2</span>,
              <span class="hljs-attr">fill</span>: <span class="hljs-literal">true</span>,
              <span class="hljs-attr">fillColor</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'blue'</span>,
              <span class="hljs-attr">fillOpacity</span>: <span class="hljs-number">0.1</span>
            }
          });
        });
        state.<span class="hljs-property">value</span>.<span class="hljs-property">areaBounds</span> = bounds;
        state.<span class="hljs-property">value</span>.<span class="hljs-property">areaCenter</span> = [lng / count, lat / count];
        <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (!noFit) map.<span class="hljs-title function_">fitBounds</span>({bounds, <span class="hljs-attr">paddingLeft</span>: <span class="hljs-number">300</span>});
        state.<span class="hljs-property">value</span>.<span class="hljs-property">center</span> = map.<span class="hljs-title function_">getCenter</span>();
        state.<span class="hljs-property">value</span>.<span class="hljs-property">zoom</span> = map.<span class="hljs-title function_">getZoom</span>();
        state.<span class="hljs-property">value</span>.<span class="hljs-property">currentArea</span> = code;
      };
      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> id = <span class="hljs-string">`<span class="hljs-subst">${code}</span><span class="hljs-subst">${state.value.isFull ? <span class="hljs-string">'_full'</span> : <span class="hljs-string">''</span>}</span>`</span>;
      <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (cacheGeo[id]) {
        <span class="hljs-title function_">drawArea</span>(cacheGeo[id]);
        <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span>;
      }
      <span class="hljs-title function_">fetch</span>(<span class="hljs-string">`https://geo.datav.aliyun.com/areas_v3/bound/<span class="hljs-subst">${id}</span>.json`</span>)
        .<span class="hljs-title function_">then</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">res</span>) =&gt;</span> res.<span class="hljs-title function_">json</span>())
        .<span class="hljs-title function_">then</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">res</span>) =&gt;</span> {
          cacheGeo[id] = res;
          <span class="hljs-title function_">drawArea</span>(res);
        }).<span class="hljs-title function_">catch</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">err</span>) =&gt;</span> {
          <span class="hljs-title class_">ElMessage</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">error</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'获取区域边界失败,请重新选择'</span>);
        });
    }
</code></pre>
<p>地图瓦片来源于高德地图，区域边界数据来源于<code>DataV.GeoAtlas地理小工具系列</code>的geojson，该数据基于火星坐标系</p>
<p><img src="https://p6-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/36007b101571492bbc94652c7f9352ed~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5pWy5pWy5pWy5pWy5pq05L2g6ISR6KKL:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1788767980&amp;x-signature=6VQk5Dx7U7kSqiZxZan8cku0%2Big%3D" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>截取行政区域内的canvas地图内容，下载该行政区域的地图</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-ts" lang="ts"><span class="hljs-keyword">async</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">drawAreaCanvas</span>(<span class="hljs-params">geojson: <span class="hljs-built_in">any</span>, rect: [LngLatXY, LngLatXY], zoom: <span class="hljs-built_in">number</span></span>) {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> canvas = <span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">createElement</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'canvas'</span>);
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> ctx = canvas.<span class="hljs-title function_">getContext</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'2d'</span>)!;
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> tileSize = <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">tileSize</span>;
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> {bounds, offset, start, end} = <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">getTileInfo</span>(rect, zoom);
    canvas.<span class="hljs-property">width</span> = end[<span class="hljs-number">0</span>] - start[<span class="hljs-number">0</span>];
    canvas.<span class="hljs-property">height</span> = end[<span class="hljs-number">1</span>] - start[<span class="hljs-number">1</span>];    
    <span class="hljs-comment">//绘制遮罩</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> maskPath = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Path2D</span>();
    <span class="hljs-title function_">travelGeo</span>(geojson, <span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">paths: <span class="hljs-built_in">Array</span>&lt;[<span class="hljs-built_in">number</span>, <span class="hljs-built_in">number</span>]&gt;</span>) =&gt;</span> {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> r = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Path2D</span>();
      paths.<span class="hljs-title function_">forEach</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">a, index: <span class="hljs-built_in">number</span></span>) =&gt;</span> {
        <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> b = <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">isGc</span> ? a : <span class="hljs-title function_">gcTowgs84</span>(a[<span class="hljs-number">0</span>], a[<span class="hljs-number">1</span>]);
        <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> p = <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">lnglat2xy</span>(b, zoom);
        <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> point = [p[<span class="hljs-number">0</span>] - start[<span class="hljs-number">0</span>], p[<span class="hljs-number">1</span>] - start[<span class="hljs-number">1</span>]];
        <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (index === <span class="hljs-number">0</span>) r.<span class="hljs-title function_">moveTo</span>(point[<span class="hljs-number">0</span>], point[<span class="hljs-number">1</span>]);
        <span class="hljs-keyword">else</span> r.<span class="hljs-title function_">lineTo</span>(point[<span class="hljs-number">0</span>], point[<span class="hljs-number">1</span>]);
      });
      r.<span class="hljs-title function_">closePath</span>();
      maskPath.<span class="hljs-title function_">addPath</span>(r);
    });
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> queue = [];
    <span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> (<span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> x = bounds[<span class="hljs-number">0</span>][<span class="hljs-number">0</span>], i = <span class="hljs-number">0</span>; x &lt; bounds[<span class="hljs-number">1</span>][<span class="hljs-number">0</span>]; x++, i++) {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> (<span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> y = bounds[<span class="hljs-number">0</span>][<span class="hljs-number">1</span>], j = <span class="hljs-number">0</span>; y &lt; bounds[<span class="hljs-number">1</span>][<span class="hljs-number">1</span>]; y++, j++) {
        queue.<span class="hljs-title function_">push</span>({
          x,
          y,
          <span class="hljs-attr">imageX</span>: i * tileSize + offset[<span class="hljs-number">0</span>],
          <span class="hljs-attr">imageY</span>: j * tileSize + offset[<span class="hljs-number">1</span>]
        });
      }
    }
    <span class="hljs-comment">//排序优先绘制有缓存的瓦片</span>
    queue.<span class="hljs-title function_">sort</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">a: <span class="hljs-built_in">any</span>, b: <span class="hljs-built_in">any</span></span>) =&gt;</span> {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> id1 = <span class="hljs-string">`<span class="hljs-subst">${a.x}</span>-<span class="hljs-subst">${a.y}</span>-<span class="hljs-subst">${zoom}</span>`</span>;
      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> id2 = <span class="hljs-string">`<span class="hljs-subst">${b.x}</span>-<span class="hljs-subst">${b.y}</span>-<span class="hljs-subst">${zoom}</span>`</span>;
      <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">cacheTiles</span>[id1]) <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> -<span class="hljs-number">1</span>;
      <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (<span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-property">cacheTiles</span>[id2]) <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="hljs-number">1</span>;
      <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="hljs-number">0</span>;
    });
    <span class="hljs-comment">//异步加载图片绘制到canvas上，http1.1的同一个域名下TCP并发连接数4-8个，通常6个。</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> (<span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> i = <span class="hljs-number">0</span>; i &lt; queue.<span class="hljs-property">length</span>; i = i + <span class="hljs-number">6</span>) {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> list = queue.<span class="hljs-title function_">slice</span>(i, i + <span class="hljs-number">6</span>);
      <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Promise</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">all</span>(
        list.<span class="hljs-title function_">map</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">a</span>) =&gt;</span> <span class="hljs-variable language_">this</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">drawTileImage</span>(ctx, a.<span class="hljs-property">x</span>, a.<span class="hljs-property">y</span>, zoom, a.<span class="hljs-property">imageX</span>, a.<span class="hljs-property">imageY</span>))
      );
    }
    <span class="hljs-comment">//截取行政区域内</span>
    ctx.<span class="hljs-property">globalCompositeOperation</span> = <span class="hljs-string">'destination-in'</span>;
    ctx.<span class="hljs-property">fillStyle</span> = <span class="hljs-string">'#000'</span>;   
    ctx.<span class="hljs-title function_">fill</span>(maskPath);
    <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> {canvas, queue};
  }
</code></pre>
<p><img src="https://p6-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/e79ec6838bdb4232ba5bf06462946ad7~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5pWy5pWy5pWy5pWy5pq05L2g6ISR6KKL:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1788767980&amp;x-signature=gwHi6zku3kzlZTtp38ZbIsPNlTw%3D" alt="11.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><strong>注意：</strong> 因为浏览器中canvas大小限制，无法截取较大缩放层级的行政区域图。</p>
<h2 data-id="heading-5">4.下载行政区域瓦片图</h2>
<p>1.基于上面的代码改一下</p>
<ul>
<li>将canvas的大小改成<code>索引范围*tileSize</code></li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="hljs language-ts" lang="ts">canvas.<span class="hljs-property">width</span> = (bounds[<span class="hljs-number">1</span>][<span class="hljs-number">0</span>] - bounds[<span class="hljs-number">0</span>][<span class="hljs-number">0</span>]) * tileSize;
canvas.<span class="hljs-property">height</span> = (bounds[<span class="hljs-number">1</span>][<span class="hljs-number">1</span>] - bounds[<span class="hljs-number">0</span>][<span class="hljs-number">1</span>]) * tileSize;
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li>绘制坐标修改一下</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="hljs language-ts" lang="ts"><span class="hljs-comment">//截取行政区域的遮罩坐标，反向偏移</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> point =[p[<span class="hljs-number">0</span>] - start[<span class="hljs-number">0</span>] - offset[<span class="hljs-number">0</span>], p[<span class="hljs-number">1</span>] - start[<span class="hljs-number">1</span>] - offset[<span class="hljs-number">1</span>]]

<span class="hljs-comment">//瓦片索引与canvas上的坐标，不再需偏移</span>
 queue.<span class="hljs-title function_">push</span>({
          x,
          y,
          <span class="hljs-attr">imageX</span>: i * tileSize 
          <span class="hljs-attr">imageY</span>:j * tileSize  
        });
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li>关闭缓存瓦片排序，避免索引顺序混乱</li>
</ul>
<p>2.根据索引坐标依次切割canvas成瓦片大小<code>tileSize</code>宽高的图片，并写入到zip包中</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-ts" lang="ts"><span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">splitMapCanvas</span> = (<span class="hljs-params">
  zip: JSZip,
  canvas: HTMLCanvasElement,
  zoom: <span class="hljs-built_in">number</span>,
  tileSize: <span class="hljs-built_in">number</span>,
  queue: <span class="hljs-built_in">Array</span>&lt;{x: <span class="hljs-built_in">number</span>; y: <span class="hljs-built_in">number</span>}&gt;
</span>) =&gt; {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> idx = <span class="hljs-number">0</span>;
  <span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> (<span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> x = <span class="hljs-number">0</span>; x &lt; canvas.<span class="hljs-property">width</span>; x += tileSize) {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> (<span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> y = <span class="hljs-number">0</span>; y &lt; canvas.<span class="hljs-property">height</span>; y += tileSize) {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> {<span class="hljs-attr">x</span>: x1, <span class="hljs-attr">y</span>: y1} = queue[idx];
      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> tempCanvas = <span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">createElement</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'canvas'</span>);
      tempCanvas.<span class="hljs-property">width</span> = tileSize;
      tempCanvas.<span class="hljs-property">height</span> = tileSize;
      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> tempctx = tempCanvas.<span class="hljs-title function_">getContext</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'2d'</span>)!;
      tempctx.<span class="hljs-title function_">drawImage</span>(canvas, x, y, tileSize, tileSize, <span class="hljs-number">0</span>, <span class="hljs-number">0</span>, tileSize, tileSize);
      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> base64 = tempCanvas.<span class="hljs-title function_">toDataURL</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'image/png'</span>);
      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> file = <span class="hljs-title function_">convertBase64UrlToFile</span>(base64, zoom + <span class="hljs-string">'.png'</span>);
      zip.<span class="hljs-title function_">file</span>(<span class="hljs-string">`tiles/<span class="hljs-subst">${zoom}</span>/<span class="hljs-subst">${y1}</span>/<span class="hljs-subst">${x1}</span>.png`</span>, file);
      idx++;
    }
  }
};
</code></pre>
<h2 data-id="heading-6">5.验证</h2>
<p>可以绘制网格索引，方便验证下载的zip包中瓦片位置是否正确</p>
<p><img src="https://p6-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/c015fde29b1c44f8a18fec97765393aa~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5pWy5pWy5pWy5pWy5pq05L2g6ISR6KKL:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1788767980&amp;x-signature=YXC4stieY%2BfQQS2QnjqQ7KohStg%3D" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>也可以直接修改瓦片地址路径进行验证</p>

<p>当然也可以用leaflet或openlayer进行验证</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-ts" lang="ts"><span class="hljs-comment">//leaflet</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> map = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> L.<span class="hljs-title function_">map</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'container'</span>, {
            <span class="hljs-attr">attributionControl</span>: <span class="hljs-literal">false</span>,
            <span class="hljs-attr">doubleClickZoom</span>: <span class="hljs-literal">false</span>,
            <span class="hljs-attr">preferCanvas</span>: <span class="hljs-literal">true</span>,
        })
        map.<span class="hljs-title function_">setView</span>([<span class="hljs-number">22.629045999999985</span>, <span class="hljs-number">114.0869626738281</span>], <span class="hljs-number">11</span>)
        L.<span class="hljs-title function_">tileLayer</span>(
            <span class="hljs-string">'/demo/tiles/{z}/{y}/{x}.png'</span>,
            {
                <span class="hljs-attr">tileSize</span>: <span class="hljs-number">256</span>,
            }
        ).<span class="hljs-title function_">addTo</span>(map)
 
 <span class="hljs-comment">//OpenLayers</span>
 <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> ol.<span class="hljs-title class_">Map</span>({
            <span class="hljs-attr">target</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'map'</span>,
            <span class="hljs-attr">layers</span>: [
                <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> ol.<span class="hljs-property">layer</span>.<span class="hljs-title class_">Tile</span>({
                    <span class="hljs-attr">source</span>: <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> ol.<span class="hljs-property">source</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">XYZ</span>({
                        <span class="hljs-attr">url</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'/demo/tiles/{z}/{y}/{x}.png'</span>,
                        <span class="hljs-attr">tileSize</span>: <span class="hljs-number">256</span>
                    }),

                })
            ],
            <span class="hljs-attr">view</span>: <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> ol.<span class="hljs-title class_">View</span>({
                <span class="hljs-attr">center</span>: ol.<span class="hljs-property">proj</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">fromLonLat</span>([<span class="hljs-number">114.0869626738281</span>, <span class="hljs-number">22.629045999999985</span>]),
                <span class="hljs-attr">zoom</span>: <span class="hljs-number">11</span>
            })
        });
</code></pre>
<p><img src="https://p6-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/a45fd9ff92b14a1eb290da384fc5b2a5~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5pWy5pWy5pWy5pWy5pq05L2g6ISR6KKL:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1788767980&amp;x-signature=Pwh010hqstfBqLsZEzSCyftzp3Q%3D" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 data-id="heading-7">6.操作选项说明</h2>
<ul>
<li><strong>导入配置，导出配置</strong>: 左侧配置栏设置会自动缓存本地localstorage,如果需要切换多种不同的地图瓦片配置，可以先导出配置json,再导入</li>
<li><strong>重绘地图</strong>: 当瓦片地址，瓦片大小，最大最小层级等值改变时需要重绘地图才能看到配置修改后地图的样子</li>
<li><strong>恢复默认配置</strong>：默认是高德地图瓦片地图的地址相关配置</li>
<li><strong>手动绘制范围</strong>：左点击地图新增或更新矩形范围的第一个点，右点击地图新增或更新矩形范围的第二个点</li>
<li><strong>下载当前截图</strong>：下载当前canvas地图显示的地图</li>
<li><strong>获取当前地图范围</strong>：将当前canvas地图的范围设置为矩形范围</li>
<li><strong>下载地图瓦片</strong>：下载当前地图的瓦片到zip，可配置分包下载，<code>常用的瓦片地图选择这个</code></li>
<li><strong>绘制行政区域</strong>： 绘制选择的行政区域的边界，可选子区域，数据来源于DataV.GeoAtlas地理小工具系列</li>
<li><strong>获取行政区域范围</strong>：根据绘制的行政区域范围，设置为当前要下载的地图范围</li>
<li><strong>下载行政区域图</strong>：瓦片图合成一张大的canvas地图截取出行政区域内的瓦片内容，下载不同层级行政区域大图。</li>
<li><strong>下载行政区域瓦片</strong>：瓦片图合成一张大的canvas地图截取出行政区域内的瓦片内容，然后根据瓦片索引分别截取出新的瓦片，只有在行政区域内的有内容，会有空白的瓦片，下载不同层级行政区域内的瓦片。</li>
<li><strong>导入GeoJson数据</strong>：导入geojson，配置样式，可以在地图上查看效果。</li>
<li><strong>绘制GeoJson数据</strong>：修改geojson配置后绘制geojson数据，可以在地图上查看效果。</li>
</ul>
